newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing debt market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing debt market report.

text.p: Dutch bonds retreated late from session highs reached in the afternoon after Treasuries opened strongly, but still finished ahead on Wednesday.
Dealers said the failure to extend the afternoon move presaged further range-trading ahead, with little data for the market to seize on before U.S. March producer price figures on Friday.
Spreads to Bunds steadied after narrowing in recent days, with the Guilder curve also stabilising after flattening at the beginning of the week.
Dutch inflation data released on Tuesday had provided some support for the local market, a broker said.
The Dutch CPI rose a provisional 0.6 percent in March from February, giving a 2.0 percent year-on-year rise.
Cash activity remained scarce though, he said, with the uncertainty prevailing in most major markets keeping investors sidelined.
Market players remain braced for choppy trading in the near term, with some still seeing risks leaning to the downside. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
